fields.pax_delay_min: Passenger-minutes lost. Bus delay multiplied by how many people were aboard.
fields.veh_delay_min: Bus-minutes lost. The conventional measure, with no passenger weighting.
fields.riders_20d: Passengers past an average point on the corridor over the 20 days. Block-level counts averaged along the corridor, not summed, so a rider staying on is counted once.
fields.bus_trips_20d: Bus trips past an average point over the 20 days.
fields.rider_block_crossings: Raw sum of riders over every block. Correct as the numerator of a ratio, but not a passenger count.
fields.min_per_bus: Minutes an average bus loses crossing the whole corridor.
fields.riders_per_delayed_bus_min: People on board per bus-minute lost. How costly each lost minute is.
fields.sec_per_rider: Seconds lost by a rider aboard for the whole corridor. Identical to what the bus loses, because they are on it.
fields.share_of_city_delay_pct: Share of all corridor passenger delay in the city.
fields.peak_period: Weekday period generating the most passenger delay.
